name: Go4hosting
tagline: India-based cPanel hosting, VPS, dedicated servers and cloud with 45-day guarantee
description: Go4hosting is an India-based web host offering shared, reseller, VPS, dedicated and cloud hosting from its own data centers, backed by a 45-day guarantee.
about: Go4hosting is an Indian web hosting and data-center company running shared, reseller, VPS, dedicated-server and multi-cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) out of its own facilities in India. Its shared hosting line runs three tiers — Home, Basic and Value — each advertising unlimited storage, unlimited bandwidth and unlimited email support, with the Value tier adding phone and chat support plus free migration.

Pricing on shared hosting is quoted in Indian rupees and scales with the term length: Home starts at ₹97.50/month on a 3-year commitment, Basic at ₹147.50/month, and Value at ₹172.50/month. Shorter terms cost more per month — on a 1-year term the same three tiers renew at ₹147.50, ₹197.50 and ₹247.50/month respectively, so the advertised long-term price only holds if you prepay multiple years upfront.

Beyond shared hosting, Go4hosting sells Linux and Windows VPS, dedicated servers and colocation, positioning itself around India-focused compliance credentials (ISO 20000-1, HIPAA, PCI DSS) and claimed 99.95%+ uptime. Independent reviews note that extras like cPanel licensing, Softaculous and SSL can be billed as add-ons rather than bundled into the base price on some plans, so it's worth confirming what's included before checkout.
policies: Go4hosting advertises a 45-day money-back guarantee on its hosting plans. Independent customer reports describe the guarantee being applied narrowly in practice — some reviewers say refunds were limited to issues attributed to the server/provider side rather than a straightforward no-questions-asked cancellation — so it's worth reading the exact refund terms for your plan before purchasing rather than assuming a blanket refund.
